heading: PROJECTS
description: Selected open-source systems I maintain or build across generative AI, search, contributor infrastructure, identity, and developer tooling. Star counts are a snapshot from 20 September 2026.

projects.name: pollinations
projects.description: An open-source generative AI platform where I maintain contributor rewards, triage automation, application workflows, model curation, and developer tooling.

projects.name: search.elixpo
projects.description: An open-source, OpenAI-compatible agentic web-search and deep-research engine with Redis memory, Qdrant retrieval, MCP tools, streaming, citations, and PDF exports.

projects.name: elixpo_chapter
projects.description: A collaborative open-source repository where community members learn by contributing projects spanning software, cloud, AI, and developer tooling.

projects.name: accounts.elixpo
projects.description: An open identity and user-management platform with SSO, OAuth/OIDC, passkeys, social login, webhooks, and an edge-safe TypeScript SDK.

projects.name: terminal-ascii
projects.description: An experimental terminal renderer that converts image and video media into ANSI representations.
